title: Tomato Pasta
summary: Add a pinch of sugar to balance the acidity of the tomatoes.

steps.b: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil. Water should taste like the sea.
Add {sp:spaghetti} and cook until al dente according to package directions. Reserve ½ cup pasta water before draining.
Crush the {to:canned tomatoes} by hand or blend briefly.
Heat {oi:olive oil} in a pan. Add crushed {ga:garlic} and cook until fragrant, 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, {sa:salt} and {pe:black pepper}. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain pasta, reserving water. Add pasta to sauce with a splash of pasta water.
Toss over low heat until sauce clings to pasta. Top with {ba:fresh basil}.
